The '''father''' of [[Fable Astin/Legends|Fable Astin]] was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in training at some stage during Astin's infancy. An apprentice to [[Fable Astin's mother|Astin's mother]], he was slain by a rival Jedi.<ref name="Uhl Eharl Khoehng" />
